items:
Award-Winning, World-Class Community in WaterColor, Florida

This exceptional home is nestled in the heart of WaterColor, a prestigious
community known for its classic beach homes and world-class amenities.
Boasting an unparalleled location, this property offers the ultimate in
convenience and luxury.
Situated in Phase 4, you’ll find Publix, shopping, and delightful restaurants
just steps away. What truly sets this home apart is the private oasis feel—
your front door opens directly to a sparkling pool, offering the perfect
space to relax and unwind. Additionally, the home features a picturesque
lawn park right outside the side door, ideal for family gatherings or quiet
moments outdoors.
With its prime location and access to WaterColor’s renowned amenities,
this home is a rare gem offering a lifestyle that’s second to none.

Property Highlights:
• 6-seater golf cart
• 4 adult bicycles
• 2 screened porches
• 3rd porch w/ private access from 2nd floor master bedroom
• 2 master bedroom suites
• second-level living space area equipped with a television
• Exclusive access to Camp WaterColor, WaterColor Beach Club, 9 community resort-style pools (one being a lazy river)
• Allots 10 WaterColor amenity wristbands
• Pet-Friendly!

Sleeping Arrangements and bathrooms (Sleeps 10)
• Master suite #1- king bed w/ ensuite bathroom- walk in shower. 1st floor
• Master suite #2-king bed w/ ensuite bathroom-walk-in shower, private porch access. 2nd floor
• Guest bedroom #3- Custom built, floating twin over double bunk bed. 2nd floor- shared hall bathroom, shower/tub combo
• Guest bedroom #4- Queen bed & twin day-bed w/ twin trundle w/ ensuite bathroom- walk-in shower. 2nd floor
*Half bath on main floor off of the kitchen

Parking: This home has 2 parking spaces available at the back of the house. WaterColor offers street parking on a 1st come 1st serve basis along roads in the neighborhoods.

Need to know Information:
• Each guest 5+ must be wearing a guest wristband for entry into the Beach Club or Camp WaterColor. Paper wristbands will be
provided for children under the age of 5.
• Guests must check in and check out with their wristband at the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor.
• Coolers, glass, outside food/beverages are strictly prohibited at the WaterColor Beach Club and Camp WaterColor.
• WaterColor Beach Services- Open daily 9am-5pm
• Camp WaterColor is open from10:30am-7:00pm daily.
• WaterColor Beach Club is open from 8:30am-7pm daily.
• All pools outside Camp WaterColor are open 8am-dusk.

BOOKING POLICY:
• A 50% reservation deposit is due at the time of booking.
• The full balance is due 30 days prior to arrival date.
• Cancelation options available
• Check-In begins at 4:00 PM CST.
• Check-Out is by 10:00 AM CST.
• Must Be 25 Or Older to Rent. We have a strict family only policy. Must have 1 adult for every 2 persons under the age of 25.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Watercolor, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and near the beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach. Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and scuba diving nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with horse riding and cycling.
